//: Coverage of `npm test` (vitest + every vigiles harness). c8 reads NODE_V8_COVERAGE, which every
child process inherits, so the harnesses' spawned CLIs are measured too; `all` counts files no
test ever loaded as 0% instead of leaving them out. The run preloads test/coverage-src.ts,
which resolves every `dist/*.js` import to its `src/*.ts`, so each module is measured once.
A process that loads `dist/` directly anyway (a child spawned without NODE_OPTIONS) is NOT
counted: `excludeAfterRemap: false` drops `dist/**` before source maps would turn it into a
second, column-shifted copy of the `src/` file whose unrun functions read as uncovered.
never run by npm test and never unit-run), *.spec.ts (skill sources compiled by vigiles),
type declarations, fixtures and test/ (inputs and e2e scripts, not the package's code).
typeOnly: modules with no runtime code (interfaces and type aliases) — nothing to execute, so
`all` would count them as permanently uncovered. evalOnly: support for the paid evals, reached
only from *.eval.mjs. Both claims are CHECKED by scripts/coverage-config.test.ts.
repro/ and references/: dated research records (a replication driver, a readability probe) kept
as evidence for claims in the skills' prose and the prior-art notes, not code the package runs.
vitest.config.ts: the test runner's configuration. The pins in scripts/coverage-config.test.ts
also require every tracked source to be either included or excluded here.
